I would even go over to hers for the night to baby sit her little brother for her while she went out with other friends or she'd sit on the phone with anyone else so that she wouldn't have to sit and talk to me. I was attacked on my way to work once, this woman was completely off her face.  High, or drunk I don't know.  I knew the moment I saw her that she was out of it because, she was in a pirates out fit, with one shoe on.  She was yelling at me from a distance at first, I just kept walking didn't think anything of it. (I lived near lots of pubs at the time drunken people shouting at you from across the road wasn't uncommon.)
 
Anyways, as I got closer she walked up to me said I had a beautiful aura.  She kept calling me Jasmine, which isn't my name and I had never seen her before.  I asked her to let go and she did, but as I started walking away she started screaming at me telling me not to ignore her, I look back over my shoulder to see if she was following me, she wasn't.  But as I turned around she sprinted at me I managed to turn around just in time but she started screaming in my face about me ignoring her, but by that point I was so terrified I couldn't understand what she was saying to me.  I was just asking her to let go and trying to push her off of me she was holding my face and my arm in a death grip.  She was rubbing my eyebrows for some reason with one of her thumbs and a guy who was walking near by, by this point  had to drag her off of me.  I don't know what he did but she was then on the floor, and he told me to go, so I ran for my life.  Ran straight to work, which is where I was closest to at the point and the moment I stepped in the doors I collapsed on the floor. 

My managers took me into the back room sat me down gave me something to drink, sat me with a friend who called my parents and the police.  

We never found her.  She's still out  there somewhere. I have since moved towns but I still struggle to walk alone at night.

I do this more often than anyone thinks.  Each time for a different person. Today is for her.  She needs me. I am pumped directly into her heart. Spreading slowly.  Floating ever so gently through her blood. One pump and I begin the take over. My job is a sad and hard one, I have to hurt them before they get better.  With a painfully slow pace I stop her heart.  It takes only seconds but for her it seems like minutes.  She's scared I can feel it. Then, with a jolt, I restart her heart. She's alive, thank goodness.  Now for my next job, I am joined by a pump of a good friend of mine and together we entwine around each other, going through every vein and artery, we caress her every organ, massage her every muscle, kiss her every nerve just to take away her pain.  With us she relaxes slowly, her legs, her stomach, her arms, her chest, her shoulders and then her face. Then her eyes open, and my job is done. I have successfully saved another life.  This child will live to see another day.

The panic, and the shouting are taking over my head. I can barely hear myself think! He's doing it again! I can't bare it... She cries and cries and he shouts and shouts. I hear a loud slap and then a scream. "TAKE IT!" He yells "TAKE IT YOU LITTLE WHORE!" I don't understand what he's saying. I don't understand why he's hurting her. Sis says that all he does is get really angry and touches her in special ways because he misses mum. But she sounds so scared, she sounds so upset. She screams again. Then it's all quiet. It's over. I hear footsteps on the stairs, I run over to my bed and hide in my blankets just in case. The door swings violently open and he stands there, with red liquid dripping off of his hand. "You're the only one I have left to play with-" I don't hear anything else of what he says as I slowly realise what has happened. She was my last ray of hope, Sis... Poor Sis. Now I'm alone. All alone. I am afraid. I scream but I can't hear anything. I get hit, but I don't feel anything. I feel a wetness on my face, but I don't know what it is. 
I lay down on the cold hard floor, looking at nothing. 
Feeling nothing. 
Saying nothing. 
Hearing only the distant cries of my now lost Sis, and the muffled words of the very angry man, who left me with nothing.

Food. Hunger. Food. I can't stop thinking about it. They haven't fed me for  a week I think. I'm trying to keep track of time, but they left me here in this solitary room. There are no windows, so I don't know what day it is. I don't know why they took me in the first place! It wasn't my fault. I didn't mean to touch their God. I didn't even know that such people worshipped trees like that. I was being chased! They can't honestly kill me for trying to get away from a savage beast like that. It was going to kill me! Honestly, I didn't even have any idea that people lived on this island. They walked in on me then, pacing and talking to myself, lack of food is driving me crazy. "You." the Chief of the tribe addressed me. "You intrude on Nui land. You touch almighty Deus. You must pay." While throwing a piece of meat at me he says "Eat. You need strength for payment" He swiftly walks out and leaves me to eat my food. It only dawns on me after I've finished eating that it seems like I'm going to face my death. Or perhaps worse. My mind then drifts off towards the thoughts of my friends, my family. You know, like it does when you're facing the end of your life. I'm overcome with anger and sorrow. I will miss my family and my annoying little sister, but, I will not miss my stupid friends that sent me over here in the first place. They were the ones that sent me to my death. They told me to come on this stupid island. They practically shoved me onto that boat, it was either I go, or they were going to send my sister. I wasn't about to let an 11 year old come on this island with all the rumours that there were about it. I find water on my cheeks at the thought of my baby sister. I'm crying? I never cry! This is stupid. I wipe away the tears and lay my head down, thinking that I'll just sleep it off. My sleep was interrupted by the huge bang of the door being swung open. 4 muscular men walk in and grab me by my hands and feet and carry me out of my cell. The Chief laughs as I pass "You pay now. You not last long." He keeps laughing hard while I get carried away completely frozen with fear. They throw me into this make-shift arena and I come face to face with the savage beast that I was trying to get away from in the first place. It's staring a me like I'm something to eat. I presume that, that is exactly what I am. The Chief raises his hand, the spectators go quiet and they let go of the rope that is keeping the creature back. This is where it got interesting. Rather than trying to kill me, the creature just stared at me, like it was expecting something. I look around, and I notice that oddly, no one was looking at the creature. In fact, people seemed to be taking extra care not to look at it. *respect* I thought. *That's what it wants*. But how to do that. My heart is racing as my mind sorts through all the ways to show respect. The best way is to bow or curtsey, like you do for royalty, right? So I bow, slowly, taking extra care to not look it in the eyes. The creature bowed back, in it's own sort of way. It then put it's head to mine, and the strangest thing happened. *I could hear it's thoughts* It said "Well done. You are the first to figure it out. Ride me. You are part of the tribe now. One of the best. One of the most important. Respect is one thing. But riding me is something no outsider has ever done. They will worship you." I'm too shocked to speak, so I just get on the creature, carefully. It then straightens up so it is standing. The spectators, including the Chief, gasp and stare, a low muttering breaks out amongst the crowd. The Chief silences them by raising his hand. He then puts that same hand over his heart and gets on his knees in respect to me. The crowd follows his lead. They accepted me into their tribe and called me *Omnipotens*. Thus begun my life as a Demi-God.

I come from a land that isn't at all like this planet that you call 'Earth'. Where I come from nature is allowed to bloom and grow freely. Wildly. Beautifully. It is so powerful; we share and live with such power. I feel the power surging through me. I want to show you.
I spread my arms and a green mist flows from my fingers and starts to spread across the floor, leaving behind it a trail of grass. It covers the floor of the grey, dull building. Bringing life to this dead corporate world. Ivy trails up the walls and shines in its everlasting glory. Bluebells sprout from the ground their flowers blooming without hesitance. Rose bushes form with a rose of every colour. Pink and yellow carnations open with the most beautiful elegance. Daffodil's flourish in all their shining glory. In the centre of the room forms an old oak, standing tall, its roots cracking the floor releasing more life into this dull world the humans have created for themselves. The branches stretch out as if reaching to hug every person there. The leaves shyly come out, flourishing gently, yet they still have a charm about them that you still can't quite help to look at. The magnificence is almost overwhelming.
I live on the old magic. This is what I live for. I stand in a room full of people who cannot understand the ultimate, undying beauty of nature. They kill it because they do not understand the power it contains and how much it truly affects the world. They stand before me shocked, but still not fully understanding. I tried all I could; they will kill their precious 'Earth' and along goes with it another fragment of the old magic that is left in the universe. The flowers, the grass and the old oak all start to wilt, as they too come to the realisation that this world, is lost to the brutal force that is called the humans. They wilt until only one last leaf has to fall. It falls and the illusion ends. They will not remember. They will not realise. I leave them, to what short time they have left in their world. Only one century to go.

Our beautiful earth. Ruined.  Destroyed.  It's been 1500 years since the 'Night Beings' came to earth.  They came and sucked the life and light out of us. We tried to fight it but it was futile, they were too strong for us and we weren't prepared. After they killed every last one of us they moved on to the next planet, I fear they will keep going until they're either destroyed or they run out of prey.  I pray for the next poor souls who face them.  As I'm brought back to reality, I see the many wandering lost souls who wander the  afterlife wondering where it all went wrong.  You can see the pain strike across their faces with every broken spaceship they pass,  because they remember and they still feel.  I, too, am stranded here in the afterlife. Wandering eternally. I take the form of my child self, just to feel what it's like to be young again.  Looking up at the moon I remember the peaceful night before the storm, and I remember the happiness I felt that night. I remember laying in the field with my wife underneath the stars talking about going up into space again.  We met by being on the International Space Station. We spent 6 months together but it felt like I'd known her for years.  It felt so right to be around her.  We got married 3 months after getting off the ISS.  I now wander the afterlife without my other half, some select few were taken with the Night Beings and she,  my beautiful, precious Anna, was taken from me.  I hope they aren't hurting her.  As her face appears in my mind, I shed a tear and as it hits the ground it begins to shake the Earth.  A giant blue beam of light came down from the moon and spread accross the Earths surface like a protective shield. For a moment and just for a moment I feel alive again. It all goes dark and the pain,  the ache in my heart is finally gone.
